source.citation: Wolf's Point, at the Junction of the North and South Branches. Ornamental wood-engraved vignette by Miller after George Davis's 1832 sketch, published in Chicago Magazine, 15 May 1857, as identified by the existing project catalogue.
what_it_does_not_supply: Surveyed coordinates, calibrated dimensions or a historical camera.
Direct evidence of unchanged appearance on 1 July 1835, hidden faces or fabric, or authentic pigment.
Proof that related retrospective plates are independent contemporaneous witnesses.
what_it_supplies: The locally held credited artwork and its visible low tavern, log, gable and sign categories, subject to crop, scale, date and artwork differences.
